officialSendingAgency.name: Bangladesh Overseas Employment and Services Limited (BOESL)
officialSendingAgency.receptionOffice: 71, Probashi Kallyan Bhaban, 4th floor, 72 Eskaton Garden Rd, Dhaka 1200

evidenceNotes: HRD Korea identifies BOESL as Bangladesh's EPS sending agency and lists the Dhaka reception office.
A 2026 Special EPS-TOPIK schedule is officially confirmed for Bangladesh, but it is a Special route and is not used as a Regular Manufacturing schedule.
KEP has not yet verified a current 2026 Regular Manufacturing registration/test window in Bangladesh.

HRD Korea's generic visiting-registration guide provides a US$28 / application-sheet / two-photo / ID-copy baseline, but KEP treats it only as generic EPS guidance until a Bangladesh cycle-specific Regular notice is verified.

stages.title: Eligibility check
stages.action: KEP has not verified a current 2026 Regular Manufacturing eligibility notice for Bangladesh. Wait for the current BOESL/HRD Korea Regular notice before treating age, health or legal conditions as exact cycle rules.

stages.title: Regular EPS-TOPIK registration
stages.action: KEP has not verified an open 2026 Regular Manufacturing registration window for Bangladesh. Do not use the 2026 Special EPS-TOPIK dates as a Regular registration window.

stages.title: Regular EPS-TOPIK fee
stages.action: HRD Korea's generic visiting-registration guide shows a US$28 registration baseline, but KEP does not promote that as the current Bangladesh Regular Manufacturing fee until a cycle-specific notice is verified.

stages.title: Identity verification
stages.action: Follow only the identity/biometric instructions in the current Bangladesh Regular notice. No Special-route identity rule is imported into Regular Manufacturing.

stages.title: Registration document verification
stages.action: HRD Korea's generic visiting-registration baseline uses an application sheet with two recent passport photos and an ID copy. Treat this only as generic EPS guidance until BOESL publishes the current Regular Manufacturing checklist.

stages.title: Exam admission / schedule
stages.action: Wait for the current Regular Manufacturing exam notice and admission instructions. The 2026 Special EPS-TOPIK exam date does not apply to new Regular Manufacturing applicants.

stages.title: EPS-TOPIK — Regular Manufacturing
stages.action: KEP has not verified a 2026 Regular Manufacturing EPS-TOPIK schedule for Bangladesh. Do not substitute the confirmed 2026 Special EPS-TOPIK schedule.

stages.title: Skills Test / Job Capacity Assessment
stages.action: If the Bangladesh Regular route uses point-system skills/job-capacity assessment, the current-cycle notice must define the exact stage. KEP does not infer it from another country or from Special EPS-TOPIK.

stages.title: Final selection
stages.action: Use only the current Bangladesh Regular selection/result notice. Passing EPS-TOPIK does not guarantee employer selection or departure.

stages.title: Country-specific pre-job checks
stages.action: No separate Bangladesh psychology stage is asserted. Do not copy Indonesia-specific psychology rules.

stages.title: Medical examination
stages.action: Use only the current Bangladesh Regular medical notice and designated-provider instructions. Exact 2026 Regular medical requirements are not yet mapped.

stages.title: Employment-candidate file
stages.action: Wait for the current BOESL Regular candidate-file/employment-application instructions. Exact documents, fees and timing are not yet mapped.

stages.title: EPS candidate roster
stages.action: After official candidate-file acceptance, roster handling follows the EPS process. No private broker can guarantee priority or Korean employer selection.

stages.title: Korean employer selection
stages.action: Wait for employer selection through the official EPS system. BOESL is the Bangladesh sending agency; a private broker cannot guarantee selection.

stages.title: Standard Labour Contract (SLC)
stages.action: If selected by a Korean employer, follow current BOESL/EPS SLC instructions. Do not pay a private intermediary to obtain or alter an SLC.

stages.title: Post-SLC Bangladesh requirements
stages.action: Follow current BOESL notices for training, medical follow-up, visa documents, payments and departure. Exact 2026 Regular downstream rules remain under review.

stages.title: Visa document package
stages.action: Use current BOESL/Korean-mission visa instructions. Exact 2026 Regular Manufacturing checklist and fees are not yet mapped.

stages.title: Pre-departure training
stages.action: Complete only the official training/orientation assigned by BOESL. Exact 2026 Regular cohort timing and fees remain notice-specific.

stages.title: Final health/departure readiness
stages.action: Do not invent an Indonesia-style MCU-III stage. Follow a current BOESL departure notice if a final medical recheck is required.

stages.title: Official departure
stages.action: Travel only after official contract, visa, training and departure requirements are complete and BOESL issues the applicable departure instructions.

stages.title: Korea entry + employment education
stages.action: After entry, complete the official Korea-side employment education and handover process.

stages.title: Employer handover
stages.action: Confirm workplace, accommodation and emergency contacts during official handover.

stages.title: Residence Card / foreigner registration
stages.action: After arrival, follow current Korea Immigration rules for foreigner registration / Residence Card.

stages.title: EPS insurance check
stages.action: Confirm required EPS insurance obligations through official EPS information.

stages.title: First payroll check
stages.authority: Employer / Ministry of Employment and Labor
stages.action: Compare the first payslip and bank deposit with the SLC, working hours, deductions and applicable wage rules.

stages.title: Labor support readiness
stages.action: Keep official labor-support routes and contract/payroll evidence ready for any wage or labor issue.

stages.title: Employment / workplace-change readiness
stages.action: If a legally recognized workplace-change reason occurs, use Korea's official EPS or employment-center process and observe applicable deadlines.
